Measured. Header parent backgroundColor rgb(255, 255, 255) on Shop All and the product page. On the homepage the header is transparent and the wordmark paints white.
Measured. Homepage card Add to Bag backgroundColor rgb(238, 237, 236). Label ink is #000418.
Measured. Product Add to Bag and Buy Once backgroundColor rgb(92, 120, 153). Footer background is the same color.

Measured. body fontFamily and --font-body. Weight 450. Files are not in this package.
